timeline.title: Our Path to Impact
timeline.subtitle: From humble beginnings to a vision for West Africa's agricultural future

heritage.title: Rooted in Heritage
content: Our story begins in Odienné, a land of heritage, cultivation, and resilience. AfriNuts was not built solely on cashews, but on a commitment: to honor tradition, embrace innovation, and deliver meaningful transformation.
For decades, our family has worked hand in hand with local farmers, cultivating trust and excellence, and mastering the craft of growing world-class cashews.

tradition.title: Tradition Meets Craft
content: Cashews are more than a crop; they are our foundation. They represent a bond between the land and its people.
But tradition alone does not secure the future. To meet the demands of global markets, we must innovate while protecting the land that sustains us.

innovation.title: Sustainable Innovation
content: At AfriNuts Export, sustainability is not a slogan; it's a promise. We're investing in organic practices, water-efficient irrigation, and innovative technologies like drones and soil sensors.
Every cashew we harvest will symbolize quality, care, and responsibility to the earth. By 2031, our state-of-the-art processing facility will bring value-added transformation to our region.

community.title: Community Commitment
content: AfriNuts Export goes beyond business. It is about empowerment. Our mission is tied to the success of the people we serve.

Guided by our Islamic values, we reinvest 10% of profits into the local Muslim community—building wells, a masajid, and a madrassa rooted in Qur'an and Sunnah. This is not branding—it's an obligation.

future.title: A Rising Future
content: We are planting seeds of change. With every job created and every harvest improved, we are cultivating a stronger, more resilient future for our communities.

Africa, especially West Africa, is the promised land for those seeking genuine, long-term business opportunities. AfriNuts Export is that trusted door—rooted in the land, respected by the people, and aligned with global standards.

cta.title: Join Our Story
cta.subtitle: When you choose AfriNuts Export, you select a purpose. You choose legacy. You decide to invest in a story that redefines agriculture in West Africa.
